description: This file defines a SwiftUI view called InstancesSettings that displays information about instances, including their status, platform, device type, and errors. It interacts with an InstancesStore to observe and update instances data, providing user interface components for viewing and refreshing instances.

classes.name: AndroidMark
classes.description: A custom SwiftUI view that draws an Android robot icon.

methods.name: header
methods.description: A private computed property returning a SwiftUI view representing the header section with title and refresh button.

methods.name: instanceRow
methods.description: A private method that returns a SwiftUI view representing a row for a given InstanceInfo.

methods.name: label
methods.description: A private method generating a labeled icon with text, used for device info.

methods.name: presenceIndicator
methods.description: Displays the presence status indicator for an instance.

methods.name: presenceStatus
methods.description: Determines the presence status label and color based on the instance's last activity.

methods.name: leadingDeviceIcon
methods.description: Returns a device icon based on the instance's device family and platform.

methods.name: leadingDeviceSymbol
methods.description: Determines the system symbol to use for the device icon.

methods.name: platformIcon
methods.description: Maps platform strings to corresponding system icon names.

methods.name: prettyPlatform
methods.description: Returns a pretty formatted platform string.

methods.name: presenceUpdateSourceShortText
methods.description: Converts reason strings into short descriptive texts.

methods.name: updateSummaryText
methods.description: Generates a summary string for the instance's last update time and reason.

methods.name: presenceUpdateSourceHelp
methods.description: Provides help text explaining the update source reason.
